desc: The Camillus CAMTRAX 3-in-1 Hatchet is yet another paragon of Camillus versatility. Including a hatchet, lock Back saw, and hammer with a molded sheath to secure it all, the CAMTRAX is one of the best outdoor product combinations ever created. The overall length comes in at 12" between the 2.75" Titanium Stainless Steel hatchet blade and the 7" Lockback folding saw. Along with a Glass Filled Nylon handle and sheath that has a reversible belt clip, you can wield and carry this epic tool assemblage with the utmost security. Such secure grips and storage solutions are thanks to how we manufacture Glass Filled Nylon components. By adding glass-filled materials to polypropylene, ABS and other substrates, we can deliver the strongest, most rigid handles and sheaths so you can focus more on the challenges the field throws at you rather than the integrity of your equipment.
